newsitem.title: MONGOLIA: Mongolia unemployment rises 15.86 pct in six month.
newsitem.headline: Mongolia unemployment rises 15.86 pct in six month.

text.p: Unemployment in Mongolia rose 15.86 percent in the first six months, or up to 64,195 from 55,405, official statistics showed on Tuesday.
Unemployment was up 24 percent in the year since end-June 1996, when the jobless figure was 51,755, the figures showed.
The number of unemployed includes only those registered with local employment offices.
"There is a large number of unregistered unemployed persons. Therefore data on unemployment is less than the actual situation," the Statistical Bulletin said.
State statistics for 1996 showed the number of able-bodied people of working age was 1,086,700, of whom 791,800 were employed.
